# Shared Artifacts

This directory holds artifacts shared between team members:

- `sample_credential.json` — Signed sample credential (produced by Tufel)
- `issuer_keys/` — Issuer keypair (produced by Tufel)
- `verification_key.json` — Verification key (produced by Tufel)
- `proving_key.zkey` — Proving key (produced by Tufel, gitignored due to size)

**Do not manually edit** files in this directory. They are generated by scripts in `scripts/`.
